network.name: Robinhood Chain mainnet
network.explorer_status: blocked by Cloudflare from build host (2026-11-19)

observed_at.note: Captured while drpc still served this block (2026-11-19). Fork tests verify the pin against `totalAssets` AND `ArbSys.arbBlockNumber()` (chain 4663 is an Arbitrum Orbit chain: `block.number` is L1 height, the L2 height is `0x64.arbBlockNumber()`), then fail loudly instead of forking `latest`. Reproduce with `python scripts/fork-test.py`.

rpc.primary_note: Only keyless archive endpoints that still serve block 118337511 (checked 2026-11-19). drpc pruned it: it answers `Unknown state. First available state is 1`, and its window is only ~150-200 blocks (~60-70s at ~3 blocks/s). publicnode and thirdweb reject historical state; robinhood.dwellir.com and public blastapi reject the chain.

usdg.issuer_note: docs.robinhood.com unreadable from host (expired TLS + ISP redirect). Symbol/decimals confirmed on chain; issuer identity not independently confirmed.

deposit.why: `maxDeposit` answers 0 for every address (fresh, holder, venue itself) while `deposit` succeeds. Not 'vault full' and not a curator gate. Believing the zero makes VaultV3.update_debt a permanent no-op: the adapter would never allocate and every vault deposit would sit idle.
deposit.adapter_rule: availableDepositLimit() passes a positive venue limit through, reports type(uint256).max for a zero, and _deployFunds attempts the deposit; a refusal keeps the USDG idle and emits VenueDepositSkipped(amount, reason).

liquidity.bound: min(value of position, idle USDG held by the venue)
liquidity.why: `maxWithdraw`/`maxRedeem` are NOT liquidity signals here: both answer 0 for a 8213519595843454223149753-share position that the venue then redeems in full. The venue's own cash balance is the only bound it enforces.

probes.withdraw_30000000e6: revert (payload unstable across runs: Panic(0x11) sometimes, empty data other times)

return_semantics.withdraw: SHARES burned (18 decimals), NOT assets paid. Measured: withdraw(2000e6) returned 1972395553874949732308 and paid 2000000000 USDG.
return_semantics.adapter_rule: MorphoVaultStrategy._freeFunds measures the USDG balance delta; it never compares the withdraw return value to an asset amount.

tokenizedStrategyImplementation.note: Hardcoded in strategy source, not configurable at deploy time. Same address on every chain because it is a constant.

yearnVaultFactory.conclusion: The Yearn VaultFactory address found in brief/Kassora notes returns no code on 4663 at the observed block. Avenor therefore deploys its own factory (ADR-2). Full address intentionally not reproduced here: the earlier capture stored it truncated (0x444045c5...), and an address pasted from a truncated note is worse than none. Re-read it from the source before use; the conclusion (codesize 0) is what matters.
